keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «문어는 바다에서 가장 똑똑한 동물에 속한다(주제)» 와 «문어는 지능이 우리와 아주 다른 모습일 수 있다는 것을 보여 준다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (octopuses are some of the smartest animals in the ocean) and the conclusion (octopuses show that intelligence can look very different from our own). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: They change color, shoot ink, and squeeze through holes

boxes.qen: What is surprising about their lives?
boxes.a: Most live only one or two years

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: An octopus has eight arms, three
, and blue blood. It is very smart and can even open
. In less than a second, it can change its
to match rocks or sand. Because it has no
, it can squeeze through small holes. Most octopuses live only one or two

words: Octopuses are some of the smartest animals in the ocean.
change its color and pattern to match rocks or sand
shapes or colors that repeat on a surface
such as poisonous fish or sea snakes
able to make other animals very sick with poison
it can squeeze through any hole bigger than its hard beak
to push through a very small space
a way of changing how you look so others do not know you
intelligence can look very different from our own
the ability to learn, think, and solve problems

qs.q: Why can an octopus squeeze through small holes?
qs.qko: 문어는 왜 작은 구멍도 빠져나갈 수 있나요?
opts: Because it can change its color
evs: Because it has no bones, it can squeeze through any hole bigger than its hard beak.
In less than a second, an octopus can change its color and pattern to match rocks or sand.
Imagine having eight arms, three hearts, and blue blood.
About two-thirds of their brain cells are in their arms, so each arm can act almost on its own.
why: 뼈가 없기 때문에 딱딱한 부리보다 큰 구멍이면 어디든 비집고 지나갈 수 있다고 했어요.
Because it has no bones, it can squeeze through any hole bigger than its hard beak.

qs.q: In “they become clever hunters and masters of disguise,” what does “masters of disguise” mean?
qs.qko: «they become clever hunters and masters of disguise» 에서 «masters of disguise» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: animals that are very good at hiding by changing how they look
animals that lead all the other sea animals
animals that always keep one bright color
evs: In less than a second, an octopus can change its color and pattern to match rocks or sand.
They can solve puzzles, open jars, and find their way through mazes.
Most kinds live only one or two years.
In aquariums, some have even escaped from their tanks at night.
why: 문어는 1초도 안 되어 몸 색깔과 무늬를 바위나 모래에 맞춰 바꿀 수 있어요. 그러니 «masters of disguise» 는 모습을 바꿔 숨는 데 «아주 뛰어난 동물» 이라는 뜻이에요.
An octopus can change its color and pattern to match rocks or sand in less than a second. «Masters of disguise» means animals that are very good at hiding by changing how they look.

qs.q: How do we know that octopuses are smart?
qs.qko: 문어가 똑똑하다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: They solve puzzles and have even escaped from aquarium tanks
They have blue blood and three hearts
They live for only one or two years
evs: They can solve puzzles, open jars, and find their way through mazes.
In aquariums, some have even escaped from their tanks at night.
Imagine having eight arms, three hearts, and blue blood.
Most kinds live only one or two years.
why: 문어는 퍼즐을 풀고, 병을 열고, 미로를 빠져나가요. 수족관에서 밤에 수조를 탈출한 문어도 있어요. 두 문장이 모두 똑똑함을 보여 줘요. 파란 피나 짧은 수명은 똑똑함과 관계가 없어요.
Octopuses solve puzzles, open jars, and find their way through mazes, and some have escaped from their tanks. Blue blood and short lives do not show intelligence.

ends: How do cuttlefish and squid change their colors?
갑오징어와 오징어는 어떻게 몸 색깔을 바꿀까?

write.src: “I think <u>octopuses are very smart</u> because <u>they can solve puzzles and open jars</u>.”

write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.

write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», use a fact from the text to make your reason clear. (e.g. because they can change color in a second)
